aboutHeading: 25 Years of Floor Refinishing in Fitzroy North
aboutText: TC Complete Floors has been refinishing timber floors in Fitzroy North for over 25 years, serving thousands of satisfied clients. We specialise in the repair, sanding, staining, and polishing of solid timber, transforming old carpets and worn surfaces into beautiful, healthy floors. Our services enhance homes and businesses across Melbourne, making maintenance easier and creating cleaner environments for allergy sufferers.
servicesText: We offer a full range of floor refinishing services, from initial sanding and preparation to final polishing. Our team handles repairs, staining, and specialty finishes to bring your timber floors to life, whether in residential or commercial spaces.

services.title: Floor Sanding & Preparation
services.desc: Expert sanding to remove old finishes, smooth surfaces, and prepare timber for staining, ensuring a flawless base for your floors.

services.title: Staining & Colouring
services.desc: Wide range of stain options to achieve your desired look, from light and natural to dark and rustic, applied with precision.

services.title: Polishing & Finishing
services.desc: High-quality polish and finish application, including gloss, satin, and protective coats, for long-lasting shine and durability.

services.title: Timber Repair & Restoration
services.desc: Fixing gaps, cracks, rot, and splits in timber floors, restoring them to their original strength and beauty for a renewed appearance.

services.title: Deck & Outdoor Flooring
services.desc: Specialised services for external decks, verandahs, and outdoor areas, including multi-level designs and drain channels to enhance functionality.

services.title: Commercial & Specialty Projects
services.desc: Tailored solutions for clinics, reception areas, and other commercial spaces, including parquetry and custom finishes to match your aesthetic.

reviews.text: As a local café owner, I needed the reception area refurbished quickly. TC Complete Floors handled the staining and polishing flawlessly, completing the project on time. The floor looks fantastic and is easy to clean, making our space more inviting.

reviews.text: Managing several properties, I've used TC Complete Floors for multiple floor restoration jobs. Their work on sanding and filling cracks is top-notch, and they always deliver on their promises. A reliable team for any timber floor project in Melbourne.
